findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_demo" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Sends the user's demo request to the Catenix team by email; the team replies to the address the user gives. This is the only tool that shares the user's persona…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_demo · Private data: check_connectivity, recommend_lab_setup, decode_lab_message, plan_lab_setup, inspection_checklist, request_demo · Public sink: request_demo · Destructive: check_qc_westgard, estimate_time_saved.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_demo · Private data: check_connectivity, recommend_lab_setup, decode_lab_message, plan_lab_setup, inspection_checklist, request_demo · Public sink: request_demo · Destructive: check_qc_westgard, estimate_time_saved

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
